key_insight: Large AI models can turn solid electrolyte discovery from slow, intuition-driven screening into an autonomous, self-improving design loop.
engineering_relevance: This framework could accelerate the search for solid electrolytes that balance ion transport, stability, mechanics, and interfacial performance for next-generation batteries.
method: Use MLIPs to connect DFT accuracy with long-timescale ion migration and defect behavior.
Use LLMs to mine literature, generate hypotheses, and support scientific reasoning.
Close the loop with uncertainty-aware candidate selection, simulation, and experimental validation.
evidence_signal: The paper is a framework/review rather than a new benchmark study, so its support comes from synthesizing existing progress in databases, MLIPs, and LLM-enabled discovery.
watch_item: Autonomous discovery will still be limited by data standardization, interfacial complexity, and reproducibility across simulations and experiments.
paper_title: Breaking Bottlenecks in Solid Electrolyte Discovery with Large Artificial Intelligence Models
